While it is found in meat, fish, and whole grains, the amount in these foods may not be sufficient to significantly increase levels in your body. That's why it may prove beneficial to add a quality CoQ-10 supplement to your healthy diet regimen. Committed to crafting quality supplements that just work better, Solaray offers our Bio CoQ-10 formula intended for enhanced absorption. Along with vitamins A and E, we provide CoQ-10 as CoQSol -- a unique form of CoQ-10 known as ubiquinone that may help you get more out of your supplementation. As convenient as it is powerful, just one VegCap daily may help support healthy cardiovascular function and cellular energy production for improved physical performance and stamina. Don't let aging get you down! Try Solaray Bio CoQ-10 that is designed to Just Work Better So You Live Brighter!
